events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Runs 15 Oct 2026 to 15 Dec 2026. Pre-season activities including social events, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and 1-2 adventure rides in Bent Creek or Dupont

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Runs 1 Dec 2026 to 30 May 2027. Regular season with indoor training in January, weekend practices in February, and 2 rides per week March-May. NICA races typically held 5-6 times across North Carolina from March through May. Racing occurs all day Sunday with Saturday pre-rides.
